name: MicroInteractions UI
summary: Library of animated React components — tabs, button, input, toggle, stepper, navbar — built with shadcn/ui, Tailwind and Motion.
description: A small collection of ready-to-use animated UI components for React, built with Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui and Motion (Framer Motion). Each component page carries a live preview and a CLI command to copy into a project. Pages cover tabs, button, input, theme toggle, stepper and navbar — including animated tabs and animated buttons — and the site links out to related libraries such as coss.com, Magic UI, React Bits, Aceternity UI, Animate UI and 21st.dev.
contains: 10 component pages: tabs, button, input, theme toggle, stepper, navbar and animated/react variants
built with React, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui and Motion
